CA.rationale: Content present with an origin kind suggesting processing ('command_estimate'), but no explicit attention/allocation claim linking processing to content access.

COD.rationale: Identified content (coordinate/color), an explicit organization/origin field, and a separate status/origin are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement tied to a content's presentation; origin kinds (e.g. command_estimate) may imply processing but linkage is not explicit.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color sets with coordinates) are present.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/status metadata, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Origin/representation fields and candidate/current structure describe how content is organized and represented.
